title: save_agordo input
description: Saves an Agordo as a JSON file (Spec 019 ③, G6, W-25, W-26) — the one tool that writes, and only with confirm: true. Without confirm it answers with what it would write and writes nothing; ask the person before you confirm. It writes only inside the server's working directory, only *.json, and never over a file that is no Agordo. Every save appends an entry to the Agordo's historio (date, the wish or „Hand“, the diff of the sliders). A fixed rule locks the save like the Werkstatt's export; an adjustable one needs a Jugxo in the Agordo. Not available over HTTP.

pfad.description: The file, relative to the server's working directory (e.g. marken/provo-ruhig.json).

confirm.description: true writes; absent or false only shows what would be written.

wunsch.description: The wish the change came from, for the historio entry; absent: „Hand“.

datum.description: The date of the historio entry; absent: today.
